surface_coverage.summary: Product websites integrate through @class-kit/react, ProductProvider, and SDK namespaces; direct tables/RPCs and raw Edge Functions are outside the supported browser boundary.
Product context, auth/session methods, and current-user profile reads/self-updates expose product policy, access, capabilities, and own profile/membership details.
Customer APIs list/get caller-safe classes and register or cancel the current user's registration; backend owns visibility, capacity, approval, membership, stock, and cutoff policy.
Anonymous product-scoped signup-link resolution and published product-document list/get are public reads; document acceptance requires an active product user.
Product-authorized management covers concrete class creation/editing/publication/draft/cancellation, template lifecycle, schedule creation/preview/generation/pause/archive, and skip dates.
Management registration queues/rosters and approval/rejection operations coexist with explicit attendance start, participant update, walk-in/trial, and completion operations.
Product dashboards manage membership types/grants/ledger, profile and metadata records, product roles and permissions, and product-user role assignments.
Product management can version/archive documents and create, revise, list, soft-delete, and attach files to change requests.

API operators run product-scoped local Supabase lifecycle checks and forward-only remote migrations/function deployment; SDK operators release tagged private packages and static-host operators configure read-only deployment keys.
Platform admins create products, manage allowed origins and OAuth redirects, change auth policy/provider flags, and use explicit product keys outside browser-resolved context.
Platform control APIs create and assign product users, invite/approve/reject access, manage platform-admin assignments, and administer product roles, grants, and assignments.
Platform administrators list cross-product requests, update statuses, soft-delete request threads, and create short-lived attachment download/preview URLs.
Platform-only Trello setup, board snapshot, connection testing, work-item creation/detach, and linked-item synchronization support the canonical ClassKit request store.

Class cancellation, template deactivation, schedule pause/archive and skip deletion, membership type deactivation/grant revocation, and role-permission or user-role revocation alter availability or entitlement; each is an explicit command.

Document archiving/version replacement, request-thread soft deletion, and local PM-link detachment remove or transform current operational state while retaining specified history or external Trello cards.

Platform product truncation deletes defined product-scoped records after exact product-key confirmation; shared-remote database reset is explicitly prohibited and remote changes must use forward migrations.

known_gaps: The target-repo snapshot contains only root documentation and design archives; it contains no class-kit-api, class-kit-sdk, apps, Supabase migration, Edge Function, package manifest, or test files. Current behavior claims are therefore grounded in living documentation rather than implementation or regression-test evidence.

The available documentation names important enums and transitions but does not fully enumerate all class lifecycle statuses, registration eligibility/capacity/membership precedence, attendance transition constraints, membership-grant statuses, document statuses, or role-assignment state transitions. These require current source and regression-test inspection before complete behavior-contract pages can be published.

Repository Structure calls the parent documentation repository local-only with no remote, while ../state/repository-identity.json reports an available origin remote. The index preserves this contradiction; current checkout identity should be verified against the canonical identity artifact before repository-topology claims are finalized.
Historical design directories are present but were not used as standalone proof of current behavior; living docs identify them as context only.
